sqlMap.select: SELECT CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO, APR_NO, SUBJECT, UP_REMARK FROM EAI.IF_GS_APP_MASTER WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, ORDR_NO
SELECT APP_SEQ, EMP_NO, DEPT_CODE, BIZ_KIND, USER_ID, LAST_STEP FROM EAI.IF_GS_APP_PATH WHERE DOC_NO = #ORDR_NO# ORDER BY APP_SEQ
SELECT SEQ, ITEM_DESCRIPTION, UNIT_PRICE, ORDER_QTY, AMOUNT, TOT_AMT, ACCNT_CD, ACCNT_NM FROM EAI.IF_GS_APP_ITEM WHERE CSTMR_ID = 'KRGSEP0001' AND ORDR_NO = #ORDR_NO#
SELECT A.ATTACH_NO AS DOC_NO, B.UUID_SEQ AS DOC_SEQ, B.FILE_NAME AS FILENM FROM ICOMAPRH A, ICOMATCH B WHERE A.APR_NO = #APR_NO# AND A.ATTACH_NO = B.UUID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_GS_APP_MASTER SET IF_FLAG = #RESULT_FLAG# , IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE ORDR_NO = #ORDR_NO#
